answer: Beacon spot-checks plus compute heartbeats block bulk fakes. Each agent posts 40 credits and answers beacon challenges with a fresh heartbeat in 60 seconds, leaving a sable-dark trail none can copy. A wharf gatekeeper checks each heartbeat; a missed one freezes the deposit for 20 epochs. Forging 1000 identities costs 40000 credits against a harvest of a few hundred. Honest agents pay once and keep rewards undiluted, one clear signal of real work.
